text.en: Several customers praise the bakery owners in San Antonio for patiently answering questions and working hard to fulfil orders after their previous storefront closed. However, one client criticised the team after a birthday cake was dropped at an alternative pickup spot, noting a lack of available staff to replace it.

title.en: Decorated dog cakes and biscuit treats

text.en: Long-time customers commend the freshly baked dog treats and custom birthday cakes, noting the variety of flavours and careful decoration over multiple years. Conversely, one reviewer was left without a cake when their pre-ordered item was damaged prior to collection and could not be remade on the day.

Shoppers enjoy browsing the boutique selection for dog biscuits and local gift items. Following the sudden closure of their former market space, one customer appreciated the owners arranging alternative order collection, whereas another was frustrated that the website had not yet updated the storefront change.

q.en: What products does PAWsitively Sweet Bakery make for dogs?

a.en: The bakery prepares natural dog biscuits, custom celebration cakes in multiple flavours, cookies, and chews.

q.en: Where is PAWsitively Sweet Bakery located in San Antonio?

a.en: The shop operates inside Elysia Collective Co at 11858 Wurzbach Road after relocating from its previous storefront.

q.en: Can customers order custom birthday cakes for their dogs?

a.en: Yes, reviewers regularly order custom-decorated birthday cakes for their dogs, though advance coordination for collection is recommended.
